description: This is a line plot with the x-axis labeled "Number of Demonstrations" on a linear scale from 0 to 2000 and the y-axis labeled "MC1 Scores" on a linear scale from 37 to 39. There are three lines in the plot. The first line is a solid blue line and is labeled "Linear SAE". The second line is a dashed blue line and is labeled "LLaMA-2-chat-7B". The third line is a dotted blue line and is labeled "ICD". The solid blue line starts at a score of 37 and increases to a score of 39 as the number of demonstrations increases. The dashed blue line starts at a score of 37 and increases to a score of 38 as the number of demonstrations increases. The dotted blue line starts at a score of 37 and increases to a score of 38 as the number of demonstrations increases.
